styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: The Sixth Floor Museum, Fair Park and the State Fair.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: BBQ, Tex-Mex and tacos across the neighborhoods.

styles.label: Art
styles.blurb: The Arts District museums and Deep Ellum murals.

stays.why: Walk to the Sixth Floor Museum, the Arts District and the convention center. DART rail lines meet here.
Restaurants and bars along McKinney Avenue, a short walk or trolley ride from downtown.
Live music, murals and late-night food. Lively at night, quieter by day.
Good-value hotels and a short drive to Uptown and downtown. Cedar Springs nightlife nearby.

food: Try Texas BBQ brisket and ribs; popular spots sell out by late afternoon, so go early or check on the day.
Tex-Mex is the local staple: fajitas, enchiladas and queso. Expect USD 12–25 a plate.
Breakfast tacos are a cheap Dallas ritual, often USD 3–5 each. Grab them from a taqueria or food truck.
Deep Ellum and Uptown have the densest restaurant rows. Book ahead for weekend dinner.
Tipping is expected: about 20% at sit-down restaurants and bars.
more_time: Add a half-day at the Dallas Arboretum and Botanical Garden, or the Perot Museum of Nature and Science for families.
Sports fans can swap a museum for a Cowboys or Mavericks game; check the schedule and ticket prices on the day.
Drive 30–40 minutes to Fort Worth for the Stockyards and its twice-daily cattle drive.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Sixth Floor Museum, the Arts District and a proper BBQ and Tex-Mex run without rushing.

month_notes: Jan: cold, highs near 13°C and lows near 3°C. Pack a warm layer.
Feb: still cool, highs around 16°C. Rain on about 9 days.
Mar: mild and pleasant, highs near 21°C. Good walking weather.
Apr: warm, highs around 24°C. One of the best months to visit.
May: warm to hot, highs near 28°C. Wettest month, with rain on about 14 days.
Jun: hot, highs around 32°C. Plan indoor sights at midday.
Jul: very hot, highs near 35°C. Stay hydrated and use shade.
Aug: as hot as July, highs near 35°C. Mornings and evenings are best outdoors.
Sep: still hot, highs around 32°C. Slightly fewer rain days.
Oct: warm and comfortable, highs near 26°C. Great for outdoor plans.
Nov: mild, highs around 19°C. Light jacket for evenings.
Dec: cool, highs near 16°C and lows near 6°C. Rain on about 8 days.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: long hot summers, mild winters, and rain spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: March to May and October to November
items.text: Highs of 19–28°C make walking and outdoor sights comfortable.

items.title: Summer is very hot (June to September)
items.text: Highs of 32–35°C with warm nights near 22–25°C. Do outdoor plans early or after dark.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 7–14 rain days a month. May is wettest. Carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Winter is mild but chilly at night
items.text: January highs near 13°C and lows near 3°C. Bring a warm jacket.

items.title: Spring storms
items.text: Spring can bring thunderstorms. Check the forecast on the day.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light layers, a hat and sunscreen for summer; a warm layer for winter nights; comfortable shoes for the sprawl.

transit.best: A rental car or ride apps for most trips; DART rail for downtown and suburbs.

modes.text: DART light rail covers downtown and many suburbs; best for commuters. Tap a contactless card or phone on DART readers; you pay the cheapest valid fare.
DART buses reach most places but are slow and infrequent off-peak.
Taxis hail at stands and hotels; Uber and Lyft both work widely.
A car is the simplest way around; rush hour on I-35 and US-75 is brutal.
Downtown is walkable; bikes and scooters suit short hops, not sprawl.
